scenes.sub: The test is an agent, not a script
scenes.vo: Most AI testing demos stop at: the agent clicked the button. This one stops at the database.
An LLM drives a real browser. One action per turn, no selectors, no page objects. It signs up and invites a teammate.
I renamed the button from sign up to log in. The scripted test broke. That is the failure every team knows.
The agent passed. Same commit, same renamed button. It reads the page instead of memorising it.
But I do not trust a model to grade itself. Postgres decides: if the invitation row exists, the stage is green.
Lint, build, agentic test, image, deploy, smoke. On every push. Full walkthrough in the project.
